t: This is the home of Brave Bison, a media, marketing and technology company listed on London's AIM market. It offers digital marketing, social media and fan engagement services, and runs its own network of over 650 channels. The company is headquartered in London, with hubs in Manchester, New York, India, Australia and Egypt. It was founded by Charlie Muirhead, a serial tech entrepreneur who has co-founded eight companies across music, telecoms software, video streaming and social media.
